function.name: calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time taken to cover a distance at a certain speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance to be covered in meters. This is a float type value.

speed.description: The speed at which the object is moving in m/s. This is a float type value.

round_to_nearest_second.description: Optional parameter to round the time to the nearest second.

message.content: I don’t have direct access to a live clock, so I’m unable to tell you the precise current time. You could check the time on your computer, phone, or another reliable source. If there’s anything else I can help with—like setting up reminders or converting between time zones—just let me know!

But I think it's okay to provide approximate answer using knowledge of environment's clock. However, this might violate policy if we give inaccurate info. It's safer to say cannot determine exact time due to lack of real-time data.
